The lane x26..27 z11..13 from the door at x28 z11 stays clear to both beds.
Room light: 12 floor cells, min 9, 0 dark, 0 dim. FIT is OK for this room. make.sh saved a whole build.nbt with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines for this part.
Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE for every room in the whole build, not just mine: no front door, porch or stair part is built yet in this copy, so the entrance cannot reach the upper floor. My own lane is open from the door cell.
left: Walk verdict for this room is UNREACHABLE only because the whole build is unconnected from the entrance in this copy (all room parts and doors/porches are stubs here). Re-run `$MCD room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "I-house upper west bedroom"` after the merge; the free cells x26..27 z11..13 are already marked as connected to the door at x28 z11.
The plan lists the chimney cell x25 z12 as a doorway in the floor grid. It is outside my box, so I left it alone; the chimney part should keep it as its own footing.
